title: Next-Gen Xbox Could Cost Up to $1800, Report Says
excerpt: Microsoft is aiming for a 2028 release for its next-generation Xbox, which a report suggests could carry a high price tag.
body_html:
Microsoft is currently aiming for a 2028 release window for its next-generation Xbox console. According to recent details from a profile featuring the head of Xbox, the upcoming hardware could potentially come with a very high cost, reaching up to $1,800.

As plans are still developing for the future console release, further official details regarding pricing and hardware specifications have not been finalized or fully disclosed.
